# Function

> Function is an independent brand strategy practice that helps consumer brands outperform their peers by fixing or preventing the causes of brand dysfunction that are limiting their potential.

Function was founded in June 2026 by John Winterkorn and is based in New York. It works with consumer companies, including multi-brand portfolios. All work is billed as a fixed fee, agreed up front.

Function (thisisfunction.io) is not related to Function Health.

## Brand dysfunction

Brand dysfunction is the gap between what a brand is supposed to do for the business and what it actually does.

- [What is brand dysfunction?](https://www.thisisfunction.io/brand-dysfunction/): What brand dysfunction is, why it happens, and how to recognize where your brand sits.

## What Function works on

- [Positioning that gets used](https://www.thisisfunction.io/positioning.html): How Function works on positioning that everyone signed off on but nobody uses to make decisions.
- [Earning relevance](https://www.thisisfunction.io/relevance.html): How Function works with established brands that are still familiar but fading from what their buyers care about.
- [Portfolios and brand architecture](https://www.thisisfunction.io/portfolio.html): How Function works with multi-brand companies whose brands have started competing with each other, and with brands stretched across more products than the name can carry.
- [Launches and renovation](https://www.thisisfunction.io/launches.html): How Function works on new products and redesigns whose sales didn't match their research scores.
- [How marketing gets made](https://www.thisisfunction.io/marketing-operations.html): How Function works on the briefs, approvals, agency rosters, and planning processes that shape a marketing team's work.

## How to work with Function

- [The diagnostic](https://www.thisisfunction.io/diagnostic.html): Function's fixed-fee diagnostic: an outside read on how healthy your brand is, what's causing it to drift, and what would make it functional again.
- Projects, scoped to the problem, and ongoing partnership on a fixed monthly fee. See the [home page](https://www.thisisfunction.io/).

## About

- [John Winterkorn](https://www.thisisfunction.io/about.html): John Winterkorn founded Function after more than fifteen years in marketing, most of them in brand strategy, most recently leading Church & Dwight's brand portfolio at Razorfish.
- Client results described on the site come from work John did before founding Function.
